'''Wembly's BLX Droid''' served aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He followed [[Imperial Corrections Officer|ICO]] [[Wembly]] everywhere, an accompaniment that other officers on board the ''Purge'' would not have tolerated.

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the droid was on board the ''Purge'' when it broke down while en route to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]]. When a boarding party was sent to a nearby abandoned [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to search for spare parts to try and repair the barge, they contracted a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]]. Upon their return, the virus spread throughout the ''Purge'', infecting almost everyone aboard, including Wembly. Wembly would soon succumb to the virus, and with his [[Death/Legends|death]], his droid would appear utterly lost without its master.<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>
